# SVG to Code - Multi-Framework Vector Component Generator
> https://ahmedelazabdev.github.io/svgtocode/

## Overview
SVG to Code is a client-side developer application engineered to transform raw Scalable Vector Graphics (SVG) markup into production-ready frontend components and stylesheet assets. It bridges the gap between design tool exports and modern component frameworks including React (JSX/TSX), React Native (react-native-svg), Vue 3 SFCs, and CSS Data URIs.

## Technical Transformations
- React (JSX): Automatically maps kebab-case SVG attributes (stroke-width, fill-rule, clip-path) to camelCase JSX properties (strokeWidth, fillRule, clipPath), replaces `class` with `className`, and adds `{...props}` forwarding.
- React Native: Converts standard lowercase vector DOM nodes (`<svg>`, `<path>`, `<circle>`, `<rect>`) into capitalized `react-native-svg` primitives (`<Svg>`, `<Path>`, `<Circle>`, `<Rect>`), bundling necessary named imports.
- Vue 3: Generates Single-File Components (SFC) encapsulated in `<template>` tags.
- CSS Data URI: Strips whitespace and applies safe URL encoding to generate ready-to-paste `background-image: url("data:image/svg+xml,...")` declarations without base64 overhead.
- Base64: Compiles RFC 4648 data URIs (`data:image/svg+xml;base64,...`) for offline and standalone embedding.
- Color Inversion: Replaces static color fills and strokes with `currentColor` for dynamic theme inheritance.

## Privacy & Performance
- Execution: 100% Client-side JavaScript execution in-browser via DOMParser and regex engines.
- Security: Zero server requests, no graphic transmission, fully private offline execution.
- Zero CLS: Preloaded responsive layout preventing layout shifts.
